spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_takedown.name: Takedown
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_takedown.descr: Bare-handed, at your lock-on foe (or the one in your sights). Time Flow: at 8 combo time stops round him for a beatdown and he's left downed; at 16 the nearest other goes down too. Web: at 8 of your hit streak he's webbed and slammed down (two at 16); from a perch above him, he's strung up.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_blink.name: Shadow Blink
spell.jaymoskingdoms.move_blink.descript: Time Flow, 3 combo. At a foe you've hit with something thrown or shot: you blink to his back and strike.
